text_block_list.text:
A large red-and-white striped tent comes 
into view. As I pull out my ticket with 
excitement, the fragrant aroma of butter 
tickles my nose from somewhere nearby.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"—Shall I take your hand? 
My little lost lamb."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, did that tickle? Sorry about that. 
Those cute ears of yours were right there, 
so I couldn't resist a little mischief."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"The venue is right up ahead! 
Are you ready to have a truly buono time?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"We're gonna leave you fuuuuull and 
totally satisfied, guaranteed!! 
Come on, let's gooo!!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Probieren Sie! 
Sweet and rich, just like Stollen—"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Even if things suck, you'll be like, 'eh, 
whatever~'? 
Look forward to the best time ever that'll 
put you in that exact mood~."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, it's right over there! Can you see 
it too? Can you hear it? 
—A premonition of something extra-large 
and marvelous☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha☆ Welcome! 
To the 'Delicious☆Marvelous★Circus'!!"
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was still little, the circus 
came to town!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"There were so many stalls lined up! It 
was marvelous even before the show 
started☆ 
The smell of popcorn, the excited voices 
of kids, colorful balloons!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"—And when you stepped inside, it was 
packed to the brim with thrills!! 
Every single performer knew the risks full 
well, yet—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"They soared through the air. They danced 
across the sky—all for the audience's 
smiles. What they created was a Marvelous 
that only people who have polished their 
desire to entertain can deliver☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, my heart was racing the whole 
time☆ I was blown away over and over! 
And that's when I thought... Someday, I 
want to do something like that too—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to take on the 
challenge☆ 
A circus for the Holy Hoof Festival!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"...I am sorry, Marvelous-san. We fully 
understand your enthusiasm, but... the 
teachers simply wouldn't give their 
approval..."

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
A circus might be impossible as things 
stand right now...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaattt!!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I see... Why didn't they approve it? 
Could you tell us the specific reasons?"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. The two major issues raised were 
'personnel' and 'safety'—"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"...On a scale this large, there is simply 
no precedent. So their first concern is 
that you won't be able to gather enough 
staff and the project will collapse..."

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"As for safety—if any of these acts fail, 
it will lead straight to injury. 
They said they cannot permit an attraction 
at the Fan Appreciation Festival that 
would make fans worry."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, I see. 
Then all we have to do is clear those two 
hurdles, right?☆"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No, theoretically speaking, yes! 
But... that is not an easy task, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!! 
I know it's super hard to pull off, of 
course! But—"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
True Marvelous lies beyond that 
struggle☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"It might be hard. It might be impossible. 
Overturning all that is what makes it 
MARVELOUUUUS☆ So, let's do this!!!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
Holy Hoof Festival Executive Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
"...A-All right. 
I will do everything I can to support you 
in making it happen!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, thank you~! —All right! 
First things first, let's gather some 
friends! Yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Haaaaah... Unbelievable. 
Losing my fake nail... That was from my 
A-tier set, seriously~~!?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Please do not be so discouraged. I will 
help you look for it again later. 
Let us check around the cafeteria next."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... Thanks, Flash-san... You're 
seriously ranked number one for 'Umamusume 
I want by my side when I'm overwhelmed', 
for real... Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"All right, one more time. When I snap my 
fingers? 
There!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? What was that!? 
How'd she even do that, seriously!?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Here you go~! ...Huh? Not carrot flavor? 
Then how about this one? ...Or maybe this 
one?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, what the heck!? 
Is her pocket some kind of alternate 
dimension~!?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Yeah! Thanks for clapping along☆ 
Here it comeeees... Hup★☆★"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, sick!! She can do that!? 
I've never even seen that on Umatok!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone~, thank you so much for watching 
today~♪ 
Actually, we're going to put on a circus 
at the Holy Hoof Festival too~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"We'd be super happy if you'd like to join 
in~. 
Here! Take a flyer~!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
".........Ah! 
I was completely captivated before I even 
realized it."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Riiight~? That was pretty fun! 
Plus, it totally boosted my mood! In 
literally two seconds."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...A circus, huh? 
Aha, sounds pretty fun!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"So yeah, count me in! 
We're gonna hype this circus up to the 
max! Ayyy☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Yayyy☆ Jordan is joining our crew! 
...Hey hey, how about you, Flash~? Let's 
do the circus together★☆★"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. While there seem to be many 
challenges... I believe it is an 
attraction with genuine power to bring joy 
to others."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I too... Fastnacht. It reminded 
me of the excitement 
I felt watching the carnival back home. 
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If it is of any help, I would be glad to 
lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. Please wait a moment. You haven't 
even received permission yet? 
"Staffing"? "Safety"? Only after resolving 
these can we proceed?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yep. First, we solve the issues and get 
things rolling 
to make this circus happen! —Let's give it 
our all together, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Having accepted, I will see 
it through to the end. I will make 
achieving our goal 
a quota and formulate a meticulous 
schedule, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ......Streng dich an!
